See a website design you love? Huescribe turns it into a prompt for your AI app.
Open the side panel and point at anything. An outline shows what you're about to pick.
Press the up arrow to grow it to a whole section. Then click.
Choose what you want from it. Colors, fonts, layout, or motion.
Pick a button, and it even catches the hover and press effects.
It tests the hover and press for you, then shows each effect with a preview.
Your list collects parts from any site. Say where each one goes on yours.
Then copy one prompt, and paste it into Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable.
